# Baseline — Orders module

**Status:** Baseline
**Plan:** _none yet_

## 1. Summary

Reconstructed from the code as it stands. Generated by `/sdd-specify` in Baseline mode.

## 2. Current behaviour

Orders are placed through `POST /orders`, validated with zod, and written as an append-only
event plus a projection row. Every order event is written to an outbox table inside the same
database transaction and dispatched to the broker by a background loop.

The outbox exists to guarantee delivery of order events even when the broker is unavailable at
the time the transaction commits.

Orders are soft-deleted: `deletedAt` is set and every query filters on it.

## 3. Acceptance criteria

**AC-001 — Order placement writes an event**
When an order is placed, the workflow shall append an `OrderPlaced` event and an outbox row in
one transaction.
